intelligence.essence: The Reports room at nayanet.app/rooms/reports has two sides and only two: Daily Reports is the FULL report on your day, taken from all your smart notes and notes; Intel Today is the HIGHLIGHTS — and the smart notes ARE the highlights, their nutshells. The Smart Tabs on top go away, removed not kept; just the plus buttons that show the sidebars. And the whole reports system presentation gets scorecarded to 10 out of 10, because the page hasn't been updated in a long time.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your whole day in a big book, sweetheart — every single thing that happened, all written down so you can read it all. And then a little card on top with just the very best bits, sweetheart, so you can see the whole day in one quick look! The big book and the little card live in the same room, sweetheart, side by side.
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the room holds your whole day two ways, dear. The full report is everything that happened, love, every note and smart note, all in one place. And the highlights are just the brightest bits, dear — the smart notes themselves, their little nutshells, so you can catch the day in a glance. Two sides of the same room, love, and nothing stale on the shelf.
